Fantech Venom II WGC2 Vibe Edition Rechargeable Wireless Gaming Mouse (4000 DPI / 2.4GHz Wireless / RGB / Yellow)

Take control of your gaming setup and experience seamless cable-free tracking with the Fantech Venom II WGC2 Rechargeable Wireless Gaming Mouse (Vibe Edition), brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Dressed in a striking vibrant yellow finish layout, this high-performance mouse utilizes a stable and lag-free 2.4GHz wireless connection matrix to guarantee instantaneous in-game response. It is equipped with an adjustable optical gaming sensor supporting up to 4000 DPI resolution, allowing you to cycle through DPI stages on the fly. Powered by a built-in eco-friendly rechargeable battery, it eliminates the need for external battery replacements, keeping you in the action longer. The Venom II WGC2 features ultra-durable mechanical switches rated for up to 20 million clicks, ergonomic side grips, and a captivating multi-color RGB cycle lighting effect that elevates your desktop aesthetics. Completed with 100% smooth PTFE glides, this yellow wireless mouse is your ultimate gaming companion.
